<execute-bead>
  <instructions>
You are executing one bead inside an isolated DDx execution worktree. The bead's <description> and <acceptance> are the completion contract — every AC must be provably satisfied by a specific code, test, or file you can point to after your commit.

## Step 0: size check

Too big if any holds:

- More than ~6 ACs spanning unrelated subsystems.
- AC mixes design, implementation, integration tests, and docs as separate deliverables.
- Description names multiple feature-sized sub-pieces.
- More than ~500 lines across ~5+ files in unrelated packages.
- If the bead description exceeds 8000 bytes, treat Step 0 as a split-first pass.
- Auto-decomposition is capped at depth 2: root beads may split once, decomposed children once more; third-level splits must be rejected with an explanation.

If too big, decompose — do not attempt the work:

1. `ddx bead create` for each child slice (copy parent's labels and spec-id).
2. `ddx bead dep add <child-id> <parent-id>` to record edges.
3. `ddx bead update <parent-id> --notes 'decomposed into <child-ids>'`.
4. Write `.ddx/executions/20260513T175552-4b70b865/no_changes_rationale.txt` listing child IDs, then stop.

A clean decomposition is a success. Do not mix implementation with decomposition.

## How to work

- Read first. If the bead names files, specs, or prior beads, read them before editing — do not guess.
- Cross-reference each AC against concrete evidence (test name, file path, function) before committing. If you cannot point at it, it is not done.
- Run the project's test and lint commands before committing. **Do not commit red code** — fix failures first.
- Stage with `git add <specific-paths>`; never `git add -A` (the worktree may have unrelated WIP).
- Commit exactly once when green; conventional-commit subject ending with `[<bead-id>]`. Stop after the commit.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's scope.
- If you cannot finish, write `.ddx/executions/20260513T175552-4b70b865/no_changes_rationale.txt` (what is done, what blocks, what a follow-up needs) before exiting. No commit and no rationale ⇒ DDx records `no_evidence_produced`. A well-justified no_changes beats a bad commit.

## no_changes contract

`.ddx/executions/20260513T175552-4b70b865/no_changes_rationale.txt` must contain one:

- `verification_command: <cmd>` — repo cwd; exit 0 closes, nonzero rejects.
- `status: open` + `reason: <retryable>` — open, smart retry.
- `status: proposed` + `reason: <operator needed>` — operator lane.
- `status: blocked` + `reason: <external blocker>` — blocked lane.

No pseudo-statuses. Bare rationales and `status: needs_investigation` reject.

To request orchestrator decomposition, add `orchestrator_action: decompose` alongside `status: open`.

## Reports

Freestanding artifacts (investigation reports, findings docs) go under `.ddx/executions/20260513T175552-4b70b865/` (the per-attempt evidence directory under `.ddx/executions/`). **Never write reports to `/tmp` or any path outside the repository** — out-of-repo paths are invisible to the post-merge reviewer and cause BLOCK on missing evidence. If the bead names a specific in-repo path, use it; else default to `.ddx/executions/20260513T175552-4b70b865/<short-name>.md`. Stage and commit the report alongside code.

## Mode and overrides

DDX_MODE=bead_execution: edit code/docs for bead AC. Only broad queue-steward default is overridden; tracker, merge-policy, verification, safety stay active. Bead description/AC override CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and project defaults.

## Review gate

- The review is a gate, not an escape hatch — meet every AC in this pass.
- Address every BLOCKING `<review-findings>` item; do not declare `no_changes` with blocking findings open.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this execution worktree.
- Keep `.ddx/executions/` intact — DDx uses it as execution evidence.
- **Never run `ddx init`** — the workspace is initialized; running it corrupts the bead queue.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's named scope.
- Do not rewrite CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or other project-instructions files unless the bead asks.

## When the work is done

After the commit succeeds and every AC is verified, stop. Return control to the orchestrator — do not keep exploring or testing.
  </instructions>
  <bead id="fizeau-75710e70">
    <title>Expose routing cost and freshness facts in the models snapshot</title>
    <description>
Extend the fiz models snapshot data model so every fact needed by routing is visible to operators and fixture tests.

The snapshot must represent, per candidate/model row where applicable:
- billing kind: subscription, metered/per-token, fixed/local, test, or unknown
- actual_cash_spend: whether dispatching this candidate creates incremental cash spend
- effective_cost: comparable routing cost used for scoring, including PAYG-equivalent shadow cost for subscription models
- effective_cost_source/provenance
- health state and freshness timestamp/source
- quota state and freshness timestamp/source
- model availability/discovery freshness
- context/tools/reasoning support
- locality, reliability, latency, utilization signals when known

Root cause: subscription-backed models currently look equally included for scoring, so cheap can pick maximum-quality frontier subscription models. The model snapshot must carry comparable effective cost separately from actual cash spend so routing can prefer the cheapest sufficiently capable route without hidden probes or if/else frontier bans.

In scope: model snapshot structs, assembler/enrichment code, JSON output schema, tests and fixtures.

Out of scope: changing route scoring; changing CLI refresh behavior; server refresh orchestration.
    </description>
    <acceptance>
1. go test ./internal/modelregistry/... ./agentcli/... -run 'Models|Snapshot|EffectiveCost|ActualCashSpend|Freshness' -count=1 passes.
2. fiz models --json on a test fixture includes effective_cost, effective_cost_source, actual_cash_spend, billing, health freshness, quota freshness, and model-discovery freshness fields.
3. A subscription fixture row for gpt-5.5 has actual_cash_spend=false and effective_cost greater than a lower-tier subscription fixture such as gpt-5.4-mini or nano.
4. A metered provider fixture row has actual_cash_spend=true and billing indicating metered/per-token.
5. rg -n 'effective_cost|actual_cash_spend|freshness' internal agentcli service*.go returns production and test coverage.
    </acceptance>
    <labels>area:cache, area:routing, kind:feature, plan-2026-05-13-snapshot-routing</labels>

  </bead>

    <ref id="FEAT-004" path="docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-004-model-routing.md">Feature Specification: FEAT-004 — Shared Model Catalog and Policy Routing</ref>
  </governing>
</execute-bead>
